existingClaims.reason: The CCTA 06H121026ED module is a plausible repair-role match and both destinations are exact product pages, but its 2009-2017/2018 Limited scope exists only in prose. The stored part has no enforceable fitment or variant scope, so it can be shown to redesigned 2018-2021 DGUA vehicles where it is not the stated part.

reviewedSourceEvidence.howToFix: Begin with a cold cooling-system pressure test and trace the leak before replacing parts. Ask a Volkswagen dealer to check the VIN for any applicable water-pump warranty extension. For the CCTA engine, the current genuine complete module is 06H-121-026-ED. On the redesigned DGUA Tiguan, the current thermostat/housing is 06L-121-111-P, which supersedes 06L-121-111-J, while the separate mechanical pump is 06L-121-012-L. Replace only the component confirmed to have failed. Refill with Volkswagen-approved G12Evo service coolant and verify the required quantity and bleed procedure. Confirm the VIN, engine code, and 2018 model generation before ordering.
